title: Grateful Dead Live at Cardinal Stadium on 1990-07-06
lineage: Charlie Miller Transfer: Dat > Sony PCM r500 > Tascam DA-3000 > wav 16/48
source: Dave Brotman Master DAT Recording: Set I: (FOB) Schoeps CMC5/MK4 (ortf) > M1000 Cables > Oade Pre-Amp > Dat (Panasonic SV-255/48k) Set II: (FOB) Schoeps CMC5/MK21 (spaced) > M1000 Cables > Oade Pre-Amp > Dat (Panasonic SV-255/48k)

ai_review.summary: Terribly muddy, low‑volume mix but an exceptionally tight performance, especially the He's Gone jam.
ai_review.review: The show is praised as a very well‑played set despite the worst sounding PA the reviewer has ever experienced – muddy and low in volume. While the recording (likely audience) is poor, the musicianship shines, with the He's Gone jam highlighted as a standout moment.

ai_rating.rationale: Review notes an excellent musical performance (≈4/5) but a poor recording quality (≈2/5); weighted average yields ~3.4 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Muddy, low‑volume sound due to PA problems; the taper’s mix is not at fault but the overall audio is terrible.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Performance praised despite disastrous sound; reviewers emphasize that the band played extremely well throughout.
